defmodule ChatServer.SessionManager do
  use GenServer

  @session_ttl 3600_000
  @token_bytes 32

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, opts)
  end

  def init(_) do
    {:ok, %{sessions: %{}, pending_upgrades: %{}}}
  end

  def create_session(pid, user_id) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:create_session, user_id})
  end

  def authenticate(pid, session_token, user_id) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:authenticate, session_token, user_id})
  end

  def upgrade_session(pid, session_token, new_privileges) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:upgrade_session, session_token, new_privileges})
  end

  def get_session(pid, session_token) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:get_session, session_token})
  end

  def handle_call({:create_session, user_id}, _from, state) do
    token = generate_token()
    session = %{
      user_id: user_id,
      created_at: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond),
      privileges: :standard,
      authenticated: false
    }
    new_state = put_in(state, [:sessions, token], session)
    {:reply, {:ok, token}, new_state}
  end

  def handle_call({:authenticate, session_token, user_id}, _from, state) do
    case get_in(state, [:sessions, session_token]) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :invalid_session}, state}
      session ->
        updated_session = %{session | authenticated: true, user_id: user_id}
        new_state = put_in(state, [:sessions, session_token], updated_session)
        {:reply, {:ok, session_token}, new_state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:upgrade_session, session_token, new_privileges}, _from, state) do
    case get_in(state, [:sessions, session_token]) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :invalid_session}, state}
      %{authenticated: false} ->
        {:reply, {:error, :not_authenticated}, state}
      session ->
        updated = %{session | privileges: new_privileges}
        new_state = put_in(state, [:sessions, session_token], updated)
        {:reply, {:ok, session_token}, new_state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:get_session, session_token}, _from, state) do
    case get_in(state, [:sessions, session_token]) do
      nil -> {:reply, {:error, :not_found}, state}
      session -> {:reply, {:ok, session}, state}
    end
  end

  defp generate_token do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(@token_bytes) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
  end
end

defmodule ChatServer.WebSocketHandler do
  @behaviour :cowboy_websocket

  def init(req, state) do
    session_token = extract_session_cookie(req)
    {:cowboy_websocket, req, Map.put(state, :session_token, session_token)}
  end

  def websocket_init(state) do
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def websocket_handle({:text, msg}, state) do
    case Jason.decode(msg) do
      {:ok, %{"type" => "auth", "user" => user, "pass" => pass}} ->
        handle_auth(user, pass, state)
      {:ok, %{"type" => "chat", "message" => content}} ->
        handle_chat(content, state)
      {:ok, %{"type" => "join_room", "room" => room}} ->
        handle_join(room, state)
      _ ->
        {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(%{error: "unknown_command"})}, state}
    end
  end

  defp handle_auth(user, pass, state) do
    case ChatServer.Auth.verify_credentials(user, pass) do
      {:ok, user_id} ->
        session_mgr = ChatServer.SessionRegistry.get_manager()
        token = state.session_token
        case ChatServer.SessionManager.authenticate(session_mgr, token, user_id) do
          {:ok, session_token} ->
            {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(%{type: "auth_ok", session: session_token})}, state}
          {:error, reason} ->
            {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(%{type: "auth_fail", reason: reason})}, state}
        end
      {:error, _} ->
        {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(%{type: "auth_fail"})}, state}
    end
  end

  defp handle_chat(content, state) do
    session_mgr = ChatServer.SessionRegistry.get_manager()
    case ChatServer.SessionManager.get_session(session_mgr, state.session_token) do
      {:ok, %{authenticated: true, user_id: uid}} ->
        ChatServer.RoomBroadcaster.broadcast(state[:room], uid, content)
        {:ok, state}
      _ ->
        {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(%{error: "not_authenticated"})}, state}
    end
  end

  defp handle_join(room, state) do
    session_mgr = ChatServer.SessionRegistry.get_manager()
    case ChatServer.SessionManager.get_session(session_mgr, state.session_token) do
      {:ok, %{authenticated: true}} ->
        ChatServer.RoomBroadcaster.join(room, self())
        {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(%{type: "joined", room: room})}, Map.put(state, :room, room)}
      _ ->
        {:reply, {:text, Jason.encode!(%{error: "not_authenticated"})}, state}
    end
  end

  defp extract_session_cookie(req) do
    cookies = :cowboy_req.parse_cookies(req)
    case List.keyfind(cookies, "session_id", 0) do
      {_, token} -> token
      nil -> nil
    end
  end
end

defmodule ChatServer.SessionRegistry do
  def get_manager do
    Process.whereis(:session_manager)
  end
end

defmodule ChatServer.Auth do
  def verify_credentials(username, password) do
    case ChatServer.UserStore.lookup(username) do
      {:ok, %{id: id, password_hash: hash}} ->
        if Argon2.verify_pass(password, hash) do
          {:ok, id}
        else
          {:error, :invalid_credentials}
        end
      _ ->
        Argon2.no_user_verify()
        {:error, :invalid_credentials}
    end
  end
end
